services.desc: Located in the scenic Fairmount Park, the Dell Music Center is Philadelphia’s premier outdoor entertainment venue. It is managed by Philadelphia Parks & Recreation. A world class amphitheater boasting 5,284 reserved seats, with an additional 600 lawn seats, the Dell offers the very best in musical entertainment, family-oriented activities and creative learning. Originally built in 1929 as the summer home of The Philadelphia Orchestra, the Dell received a $6.2 million upgrade in 2010 to restore it to its original splendor, with a striking new gateway facade unveiled in 2014.
